Build prompt

Build “Home Renovation Budget & Contractor Tracker” on NeoApps for a home renovator. Group quotes and receipts by room, choose a contractor and compare committed and actual costs. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

For a $5,000 room budget, record $3,200 of spending. Remaining budget shows $1,800.
